title: A finite morphism that is an isomorphism off finitely many points factors into glueings of pairs of points and squishings of tangent vectors
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma factors any finite almost-isomorphism into the two elementary modifications (statement lines 3257-3267). The proof (lines 3269-3321) is a complete induction on the length of the cokernel: skyscraper decomposition, the multi-point splitting step, the single-point algebra chain with the Nakayama dichotomy, and the terminal classification via the exactly-two-subalgebras lemma. Every step is present with no omitted details. H2: a systematic induction with correctly ordered hinges, each short.
